_what: THE HACKATHON DEMONSTRATION CONFIGURATION. It is `unica-sepolia.json` with one difference: the
four policy values are filled in, so the planner produces a complete, signable plan that anybody
can reproduce without holding a merchant's real numbers.
Add --gas to make it signable; the estimates are an input and the row below says which.
THE POLICY VALUES BELOW ARE HACKATHON DEMONSTRATION VALUES. They exist so the commitment and
verification flow is reproducible by a reviewer. They are not a production financial policy, they
are not a recommendation, and no merchant's real threshold, allocation, reserve or salt appears in
this repository at any commit. A real deployment fills these in on the owner's own machine, in an
untracked copy, and publishes only the digest.
_testnetOnly: `unica.eth` here is an ENSv2 name on SEPOLIA, registered by this project's deployer on 2026-09-09.
ENSv2's registry contracts hold zero bytes of code on Ethereum mainnet, so this namespace exists on
the testnet and nowhere else. UNICA claims no ownership of, affiliation with, or connection to any
mainnet name, `unica.eth` included; the mainnet name is held by an unrelated third party.
_policy: HACKATHON DEMO POLICY VALUES — see the header. In plain English, and matching how roles.mjs
thresholdWei   1000000    the smallest settlement the treasury policy acts on at all. Below it,
nothing is swept and nothing is reallocated. Denominated in the payout
token's own base units, which for Sepolia USDC (6 decimals) is 1.00 USDC.
allocationBps  2500       the share of a settlement the policy is willing to move, in basis
reserveWei     5000000    the floor the treasury is never taken below, in the same base units:
5.00 USDC. A reserve ABOVE the threshold is deliberate here — it is the
case that exercises the floor, because a policy whose reserve is smaller
than its trigger never has to refuse anything.
salt           bytes32("unica")   the blinding value. Without it the commitment is a keccak over
a small space of round numbers and anyone could brute-force the inputs.
A real one is random and secret; this one is the ASCII of the project
name, right-padded, precisely so a reviewer can recompute the digest.
Only the DIGEST is ever written on chain. commitPolicy returns the digest and the scheme string and
keeps nothing else, and the values above never appear in any transaction in the plan.
